definition: a sour substance that turns litmus red
description: In a sunny town square at a lemon festival, a young woman in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue rubber gloves squeezes a lemon above her head over a long paper test strip. The strip turns from blue to bright red, and she shouts with joy as the crowd in summer clothes cheers, claps and films with phones. On a table beside her a bowl of white powder foams over next to a glass of juice. Behind the crowd rise a giant lion and a ship built from lemons and oranges under yellow bunting.
